top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.

The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship's Missouri gravel county roads, Wine country rolling hills forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 49 miles.
When someone attacks on rolling Missouri wine country gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship's rolling Missouri wine country gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
At The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling Missouri wine country gravel. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship. Train it until it feels boring.
49 miles on rolling Missouri wine country gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on rolling Missouri wine country gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship's rolling Missouri wine country gravel actually does to you.
Torque for headwinds and rolling Missouri wine country gravel. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship’s 49 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at The Equalizer - Missouri State Championship requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling missouri wine country gravel to build confidence. Expect: missouri gravel county roads, wine country rolling hills, missouri river valley.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 49 miles of rolling missouri wine country gravel in Marthasville, Missouri.
